parameter_and_aggregation_strategy.highlight: Proposed 3-stage approach: benchmark raw signatures first (no aggregation), then block-builder aggregation, then mempool aggregation
lightclient: aggregation unlikely in Hegota; EL blocks at 2–4 MB range are manageable without aggregation; networking improvements (e.g., block witness) can offset larger sig sizes
Safe Transaction Service signature limit is <5 KB; current sphincs.art default params yield ~8 KB signatures (up from ~4 KB); Nico estimates 15–30% hash reduction possible without changing lifetime
One-time migration consensus: shipping two SPHINCS+ variants requiring two user migrations is explicitly ruled out

devnet_and_spec_path.highlight: Consensus formed: target bogota-devnet-3 (not Daisugi) with Lean SPHINCS+ and either PROOF frame or sig list — no aggregation
PROOF frame vs. sig list still undecided; EL teams need to resolve before bogota-devnet-3 spec is finalized
Interim: restart Daisugi testnet with latest Nethermind (sphincs.art default params) for baseline benchmarks while bogota-devnet-3 spec is prepared

organizational.highlight: Core discussion moved to Discord (pq-el, pq-networking, pq-cl, pq-general channels); Telegram channel to be closed
EthPandaOps (Philip) migrated Daisugi testnet to larger infrastructure; Project 11 and Nethermind assisted
Nico: deadline pressure — end-of-January target, December holidays reduce capacity; warns against further parameter drift without learning

action_items.action: Nethermind: restart Daisugi testnet with sphincs.art default parameters for benchmark baseline
Resolve PROOF frame vs. sig list to unblock bogota-devnet-3 spec; discuss in pq-el Discord
Nico to share alternative sphincs.art parameter sets optimized for permutation/aggregation friendliness

decisions.decision: No aggregation in bogota-devnet-3; ship Lean SPHINCS+ with sphincs.art default parameters into next Bogota devnet (not Daisugi)
Only one SPHINCS+ variant will be shipped; requiring users to migrate twice is not acceptable
PQTS discussion channel migrated to Discord; Telegram channel to be closed

targets.target: bogota-devnet-3 — Lean SPHINCS+ + PROOF frame or sig list; spec to be finalized in Discord before launch
Parameter and design decisions needed before end of January to meet Hegota timeline
